company.description:
Wuzzuf is an online marketplace that connects highly educated people as well as low, medium, or no education workers with employers.

WUZZUF.net is created and managed by BasharSoft, a technology firm founded in 2009 and one of very few companies in the MENA region specialized in developing innovative online recruitment solutions for top enterprises and organizations.

Since May 2012, the company successfully served 10,000+ top companies and employers in Egypt, 1.5 MILLION CVs were viewed in its platform and 100,000+ job seekers directly hired through WUZZUF. In total, 250,000+ open job vacancies were advertised and now, 500,000+ users visit our website each month looking for jobs at top Employers.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $4,000,000, or 33.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $150,000, representing 1.27% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,685,680 to $30,400,730, a 11.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
